scope: actual built single ledger with real CustomerFollowup in isolated fixture storage; no browser or provider state

tests.name: start conditions treat an omitted optional import as empty and may end without a call
a call node cannot complete from an untouched default route
actual call archive permits an explicit CLOSE END action
owner and purpose entry rules allow a store followup without returning ownership to HQ
entry sources cannot use call results and default branch must remain unique and last
same-tenant same phone across independent categories has one effective outbound lease
contact lease persists through unknown retries and is not released by one call end
frequency uses real dial facts and a disabled policy preserves existing zero-interval behavior
explicit five-level priority affects cross-category same-phone starts and supersedes historical category weights
explicit group start reports per-business acceptance and blocks only the colliding same-number row
unknown group replay and reconciliation keep each followup identity unique
manual calls remain an individual action rather than a falsely accepted group
terminated lead can change category with the same business identity and immutable old plan/import evidence
target required import data is not guessed from same-code followup fields and confirmation goes stale
native exact facts and active execution block starts while unknown reads never become empty permission
work queues and current business outcome are read-only projections and histories are not redrawn
custom line family participates in the same brand-wide lead identity space
custom line families cannot duplicate a confirmed original brand-lead source under a new category
